episodes.synopsis: The first thing Hanzawa needs to do is find an apartment to live in, but it's almost impossible to find one where a murder hasn't taken place.
episodes.title: Episode 1

episodes.synopsis: Hanzawa moves into a very nice apartment and becomes fast friends with a fellow resident. But then, a murder takes place.
episodes.title: Episode 2

episodes.synopsis: Hanzawa heads to the town hall to run some errands, but must also make a pit stop in enemy territory — the local police station.
episodes.title: Episode 3

episodes.synopsis: It's an emergency: Hanzawa starts taking a nice morning shower, only to realizes that there's no shampoo in the bathroom.
episodes.title: Episode 4

episodes.synopsis: After waking up in a cold sweat from a nightmare, Hanzawa makes a terrible decision and goes out into the dangerous streets of Beika at night.
episodes.title: Episode 5

episodes.synopsis: Hanzawa needs a job fast, but the only work available is risky, scary, and probably illegal. But desperate times call for desperate measures.
episodes.title: Episode 6

episodes.synopsis: Finally, Hanzawa gets a job at a new video rental shop. But then, the manager gets murdered — and all eyes turn to Hanzawa!?
episodes.title: Episode 7

episodes.synopsis: While stopping by a pet shop, Hanzawa has a fateful meeting with an impossibly cute, fluffy and very, very expensive Pomeranian.
episodes.title: Episode 8

episodes.synopsis: In an effort to look cool, Hanzawa goes out in search of some fashionable clothes. But watch out; in this town, the wrong outfit can get you killed.
episodes.title: Episode 9

episodes.synopsis: Hanzawa’s mother comes to check out Beika — but then a hostage incident occurs, and she might be one of the victims!?
episodes.title: Episode 10

episodes.synopsis: It's been a few months since moving to Beika, and Hanzawa hasn't gotten any closer to murdering that certain man.
episodes.title: Episode 11

episodes.synopsis: Hanzawa has finally found the man, which can only mean one thing; it's murder time! But then, a certain master thief shows up.
episodes.title: Episode 12
